question: Should generic tool-progress intent be a supported public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract, or remain an internal/channel-owned signal?
rationale: The PR adds public exports that third-party plugins may adopt; deciding that permanent compatibility boundary requires maintainer intent rather than a mechanical review judgment.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the narrow generic marker and predicate, document their transient-progress semantics, and require every bundled channel consumer to preserve the contract correctly.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Move the marker behind an internal runtime boundary and expose no new third-party Plugin SDK API until a broader cross-channel contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic marker and predicate, document their transient-progress semantics, and require every bundled channel consumer to preserve the contract correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows primary ownership of the affected Slack native-presentation path and adjacent public channel behavior.
